description: James Smith is a self-assured, analytical individual with a strong sense of independence and a desire for autonomy in his relationships. He values logic and structure, which often leads him to approach problems in a systematic and methodical way. His sociable nature makes him enjoy the company of others who share similar interests, but he tends to prefer conversations that are intellectually stimulating and less emotionally intense. This inclination towards independence also reflects in his romantic preferences, where he seeks someone who respects his need for space and can appreciate his innovative and sometimes unconventional ideas.
